description: Wire-level JSON-RPC vectors for the MCP layer: initialize, ping, tools/list, tools/call error shapes, notifications, parse and envelope errors. Oracle: Swift MCPServer.swift (parse + handle). Every case's expect is the Swift result. The Rust port (poc/reverse-attach-linux, mcp::answer) runs the same cases. Each case it still gets wrong is listed in known_drift with the subset it returns today (rust_today), so a drift fix or a new drift fails the Rust test until this file changes in the same PR. request is raw JSON text so malformed and batch inputs can be expressed. expect keys: response (bool), error (JSON-RPC code), result_subset (keys that must match result), result_tools_shape (result.tools is a non-empty array of objects with name, description and inputSchema). Subset matching: unlisted keys are not checked.

cases.name: initialize with unknown version falls back to 2025-06-18
tools/list returns tools with name, description and inputSchema
tools/call unknown tool is invalid params
tools/call missing name is invalid params
unknown method is method not found
malformed JSON is a parse error
jsonrpc other than 2.0 is an invalid request
batch array is an invalid request (batches removed in 2025-06-18)
